defects.claim: Destination-dependent group composites rasterize onto a clear target in a separate run, so they never erase preceding native LBX objects and no skip reason is given
defects.scenario: A solid black rectangle exported as a native LBX object, followed by a group with composite destination-out whose opaque child overlaps it: the canvas erases the overlap, but the export keeps the rectangle whole and reports nothing
defects.cause: raster runs split at native object boundaries render without backdrop
